scenario.name: Silent Intruder — Fiber-Optic FPV Drone
scenario.briefing:
CLASSIFIED — PRIORITY ALPHA

Intelligence reports confirm insurgent elements in Sector 4 have acquired fiber-optic FPV drones from cross-border supply chains.

These platforms emit ZERO radio frequency signature. They are completely immune to electronic warfare countermeasures including RF jamming and GPS spoofing.

The fiber-optic control link operates through a physical tether, making the drone invisible to standard C-UAS detection systems that rely on RF signature analysis.

Your mission: Detect, classify, and neutralize the incoming threat using appropriate countermeasures.

Remember: Wrong countermeasure selection wastes critical engagement time and may result in mission failure.

Good luck, Operator.

events.description: Unknown track appears on radar at 2km
Micro-Doppler signature detected — rotor blade beat frequency identified
RF Spectrum Analysis: NO SIGNAL DETECTED. Micro-Doppler confirms rotary-wing UAS.
Threat closing at 800m. RF spectrum: BLANK. Select countermeasure NOW.

wrongActions.RF_JAM: INEFFECTIVE — Target emits NO RF signature. Fiber-optic link is unjammable. The drone continues its approach unaffected. Switch to hard-kill!
wrongActions.GPS_SPOOF: INEFFECTIVE — Target is not GPS-dependent. Fiber-optic FPV drones use direct visual navigation through tethered camera feed. Spoofing has zero effect!
